/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: Massachusetts
    Focus year: 2021
    Question: In an eviction action, can a tenant rebut/raise the defense that the property is uninhabitable?
*/

/* =========================
   1) STATUTE TRANSLATIONS
   ========================= */

/* --- Statute registry (for reasoning about what subjects are covered) --- */
statute(ma_gl_ch281_s2, massachusetts, 2021).
statute(ma_gl_ch279_s8a, massachusetts, 2021).
statute(ma_gl_ch278a_s18, massachusetts, 2021).

/* Subjects of the provided statutes (derived from their text) */
statute_subject(ma_gl_ch281_s2, statutory_construction).
statute_subject(ma_gl_ch279_s8a, criminal_sentencing_effective_time).
statute_subject(ma_gl_ch278a_s18, criminal_forensic_motion_appealability_and_deadlines).

/* -----------------------------------------------------------------------
   [1] MA Gen L ch 281  2 (2021)
   Statutory construction: continuation of prior law; references construed to apply.
   ----------------------------------------------------------------------- */

% ch 281 2: If a provision is the same as an existing statute and is in the General Laws,
% it is construed as a continuation (not a new enactment).
% Deterministic given fully-instantiated inputs.
statute_ch281_s2_construed_as_continuation(Provision) :-
    same_as_existing_statute(Provision),
    incorporated_in_general_laws(Provision),
    !.

statute_ch281_s2_construed_as_continuation(_Provision) :-
    fail.

% ch 281 2: A reference in an unrepealed statute to an old provision that has been revised
% and reenacted is construed as applying to the incorporated provision.
% Deterministic given fully-instantiated inputs.
statute_ch281_s2_reference_construed_as_applying(ReferencingStatute, OldProvision, NewProvision) :-
    statute_not_repealed(ReferencingStatute),
    revised_and_reenacted(NewProvision),
    incorporated_in_general_laws(NewProvision),
    corresponds_to(OldProvision, NewProvision),
    !.

statute_ch281_s2_reference_construed_as_applying(_ReferencingStatute, _OldProvision, _NewProvision) :-
    fail.

% Minimal placeholder facts to make the above predicates well-defined in this standalone file.
% (No facts are asserted that would connect these construction rules to eviction/habitability.)
same_as_existing_statute(_Provision) :- fail.
incorporated_in_general_laws(_Provision) :- fail.
statute_not_repealed(_Statute) :- fail.
revised_and_reenacted(_Provision) :- fail.
corresponds_to(_Old, _New) :- fail.

/* -----------------------------------------------------------------------
   [2] MA Gen L ch 279  8a (2021)
   Sentence timing: when a previous sentence is deemed expired for ordering consecutive sentences.
   ----------------------------------------------------------------------- */

% ch 279 8A: For the limited purpose of determining the taking effect time of a consecutive sentence,
% a previous sentence is deemed expired upon the prisoner's release (parole or otherwise).
% Represent as: deemed_expired_for_consecutive_sentence(PreviousSentence, ExpirationEvent).
statute_ch279_s8a_deemed_expired_for_consecutive(PreviousSentence, release_by_parole_or_otherwise) :-
    previous_sentence(PreviousSentence),
    released_from_sentence(PreviousSentence, release_by_parole_or_otherwise),
    !.

statute_ch279_s8a_deemed_expired_for_consecutive(_PreviousSentence, _Event) :-
    fail.

% ch 279 8A: Does not alter or control provisions of c.127 131 or 149 (modeled as a constraint).
statute_ch279_s8a_does_not_alter_c127_131_or_149 :-
    !.

% Minimal placeholders.
previous_sentence(_S) :- fail.
released_from_sentence(_S, _Event) :- fail.

/* -----------------------------------------------------------------------
   [3] MA Gen L ch 278a  18 (2021)
   Forensic/scientific analysis motion: appealability; 30-day notice deadline if denial appealed.
   ----------------------------------------------------------------------- */

% ch 278a 18: An order allowing or denying a motion under this chapter is final and appealable.
statute_ch278a_s18_final_and_appealable(Order) :-
    order_on_motion_for_forensic_or_scientific_analysis(Order),
    ( order_allows_motion(Order)
    ; order_denies_motion(Order)
    ),
    !.

statute_ch278a_s18_final_and_appealable(_Order) :-
    fail.

% ch 278a 18: If appealing an order denying the motion, notice of appeal must be filed within 30 days
% after entry of judgment.
% We model the timing rule as: notice_timely(DaysAfterJudgment) iff DaysAfterJudgment =< 30.
statute_ch278a_s18_notice_of_appeal_timely_if_denial(DaysAfterJudgment) :-
    integer(DaysAfterJudgment),
    DaysAfterJudgment >= 0,
    DaysAfterJudgment =< 30,
    !.

statute_ch278a_s18_notice_of_appeal_timely_if_denial(_DaysAfterJudgment) :-
    fail.

% Minimal placeholders.
order_on_motion_for_forensic_or_scientific_analysis(_Order) :- fail.
order_allows_motion(_Order) :- fail.
order_denies_motion(_Order) :- fail.

/* =========================
   2) SCENARIO TRANSLATION
   ========================= */

% Scenario facts encoded from the question.
jurisdiction(massachusetts).
focus_year(2021).

case(eviction_case_1).
action_type(eviction_case_1, eviction_action).
party_role(eviction_case_1, tenant, tenant_1).

% The defense the tenant seeks to raise.
asserted_defense(eviction_case_1, uninhabitable_property).

% scenario_statement/0 succeeds exactly when the encoded scenario is satisfied.
scenario_statement :-
    jurisdiction(massachusetts),
    focus_year(2021),
    case(eviction_case_1),
    action_type(eviction_case_1, eviction_action),
    party_role(eviction_case_1, tenant, tenant_1),
    asserted_defense(eviction_case_1, uninhabitable_property),
    !.

/* =========================
   3) APPLY REASONING
   ========================= */

% Map scenario terminology to normalized atoms used by the legal rules.
scenario_action(eviction) :-
    action_type(eviction_case_1, eviction_action),
    !.

scenario_defense(uninhabitable) :-
    asserted_defense(eviction_case_1, uninhabitable_property),
    !.

% A statute "authorizes" a given defense in a given action only if its subject matter covers it.
% (With the provided statutes, none have subjects eviction_defense or habitability.)
statute_authorizes_defense(Statute, eviction, uninhabitable) :-
    statute_subject(Statute, eviction_defense),
    statute_subject(Statute, habitability),
    !.

statute_authorizes_defense(_Statute, _Action, _Defense) :-
    fail.

% Legal availability: there exists a statute in force in the state/year that authorizes the defense.
legal_defense_available(Action, Defense, State, Year) :-
    statute(Statute, State, Year),
    statute_authorizes_defense(Statute, Action, Defense),
    !.

legal_defense_available(_Action, _Defense, _State, _Year) :-
    fail.

/* =========================
   4) DEFINE housing_answer(Result)
   ========================= */

housing_answer(Result) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_action(Action),
    scenario_defense(Defense),
    jurisdiction(State),
    focus_year(Year),
    (   legal_defense_available(Action, Defense, State, Year)
    ->  Result = yes
    ;   Result = no
    ),
    !.

housing_answer(no) :-
    % If the scenario facts are not established, default to "no" for this standalone run.
    !.

/* =========================
   5) MAIN ENTRYPOINT
   ========================= */

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).
